title: 第8章 大勇叔的任务，六力弓
slug: 乱世武道从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“嫂嫂，我好热，帮我！”

陆林感觉到体内有一团火，不，是一片火。

把他从头烧到脚。

每一寸肌肤，每一根毛发，都在火焰的范围之内。

这时候，刚刚洗了碗，小手冰凉的梁心兰，就是陆林最好的解药。

“小叔，不要这样，这……”

梁心兰一下惊慌起来。

她拼命想把手抽回，可她哪里比得上陆林的力量。

陆林稍一用力。

梁心兰竟然直直扑在他怀里。

看着那近在迟尺，与前女友酷似的面容。

让陆林生出一股时空错乱的感觉。

他不是在什么大夏国的南山村。

而是回到了地球，在酒店的大床房内。

“嫂嫂……”

“不要，唔……”

当陆林的唇与梁心兰印在一起时。

梁心兰仿若被人施了魔法一般。

定住不动。

双眼瞪大。

“舌，舌头……”

梁心兰大脑一片空白。

不知过了多久。

当梁心兰再次清醒过来时，陆林已经离开。

房间内没有声音。

也没在院子里练箭。

梁心兰只觉得自己心脏扑通扑通跳个不停。

她只是怔怔的，望着院门的方向出神。

陆林知道自己有些冲动了。

匆忙穿上衣服，披上熊皮袄就出了门。

“都怪陆杨，要不是他，我早就进城把小鹿卖了换钱。”

陆林只能把责任推出去。

而且，他也没干什么，只是请嫂嫂帮忙给降了个温而已，只是嘴唇不小心碰了一下而已，只是……

他编不下去了。

舌头都伸了，还说推卸责任的话，就有些既要又要的感觉了。

断腿的陆杨不知道什么时候离开。

陆林在村里瞎转悠，不知不觉就来到陆大勇家门前。

这一身箭术还是从此处学来。

既然来了，就进去看看，说不定能学到什么新东西。

陆林叩响了门环。

可陆大勇那粗狂豪迈的声音没有响起。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Sister-in-law, I'm so hot, help me!"

Lu Lin felt a fire inside his body, no, a fire.

Burn him from head to toe.

Every inch of skin and every hair is within the range of the flames.

At this time, Liang Xinlan, who had just washed the dishes and had cold hands, was Lu Lin's best antidote.

"Uncle, don't be like this, this..."

Liang Xinlan suddenly panicked.

She desperately tried to pull her hand away, but she was no match for Lu Lin's strength.

Lu Lin exerted a little force.

Liang Xinlan actually threw herself into his arms.

Looking at the face that was so close to Chi Chi, he looked very similar to his ex-girlfriend.

Lu Lin felt a sense of confusion in time and space.

He is not in Nanshan Village in Daxia Kingdom.

Instead, he returned to Earth, in a hotel's big bed room.

"Sister-in-law..."

"No, um..."

When Lu Lin's lips were pressed together with Liang Xinlan's.

Liang Xinlan seemed to have been cast under a spell.

Stay still.

Eyes widened.

"Tongue, tongue..."

Liang Xinlan's mind went blank.

I don’t know how much time passed.

When Liang Xinlan woke up again, Lu Lin had already left.

There was no sound in the room.

I didn’t practice archery in the yard either.

Liang Xinlan felt that her heart was beating continuously.

She was just in a daze, looking in the direction of the courtyard door in trance.

Lu Lin knew that he was a little impulsive.

He hurriedly put on his clothes, put on his bearskin coat and went out.

"It's all Lu Yang's fault. If it weren't for him, I would have gone to the city and sold the deer for money."

Lu Lin could only push away the responsibility.

Moreover, he didn't do anything, he just asked his sister-in-law to help cool him down, his lips just accidentally touched, just...

He couldn't make it up anymore.

His tongue was hanging out and he was talking about shirk responsibility, which made him feel like he wanted something at the same time.

Lu Yang, who had a broken leg, didn't know when to leave.

Lu Lin was wandering around the village and unknowingly came to the door of Lu Dayong's house.

This archery skill was learned from here.

Now that you're here, let's go in and take a look, maybe you can learn something new.

Lu Lin knocked on the door knocker.

But Lu Dayong's rough and heroic voice did not sound.
